name: Light Armor
description: Grants +1 die to Soak, and +1 die reroll on Soak checks.

name: Medium Armor
description: Grants +1 die to Soak. When taking the dash or jump action, the distance decreases by 1.

name: Heavy Armor
description: Grants +1 die to Soak. When taking the dash or jump action, the distance decreases by 1. Initiating a dodge or parry costs 1 additional Stamina.
